verdict.rationale: GitLab's docs describe a versioned REST API (v4) that follows semantic versioning. They also maintain a dedicated 'REST API deprecations' page with a 'versioning and deprecations' section, which states that breaking changes will not be made within v4 and tells consumers to review deprecations regularly. An autogenerated OpenAPI 3.0 spec, tightly coupled to the implementation, adds a machine-readable contract. Missing for 10: specifics of the deprecation timeline or notice period in the evidence, and independent or hands-on corroboration of how the policy works in practice.
